name: Dev Feedback Capture
summary: Chromium extension for capturing structured feedback on pages, PDFs, and browser-visible UI.
requirements: Manual install from an unpacked extension folder
Developer Mode in Chrome, Edge, or another Chromium browser
Packaged downloads are planned for GitHub Releases

privacy.summary: Feedback history is saved in local extension storage. Capture and export actions are user-triggered, and no cloud sync or hosted AI integration is included.

distribution.current: Manual unpacked install from the repository or release zip.
distribution.planned: Versioned zip assets published through GitHub Releases.

highlights: Element capture with selectors and notes
Region capture for screenshots and PDFs
Local history with JSON, Markdown, and AI prompt exports
